caption:
A lead that sits too long is already costing you money.

Only about 17% of service businesses respond to a new lead within an hour. Respond within 5 minutes instead, and the close rate roughly doubles.

The Revenue Calculator runs your own numbers against that pattern. Enter monthly leads, close rate, average job value, and your typical response time.

It hands back your revenue per lead, your monthly revenue, and the modeled gap slow follow-up is creating right now.

Free. Browser-based. No signup, no card.

#ServiceBusiness #SpeedToLead #LeadFollowUp #HomeServiceMarketing #SmallBusinessGrowth
rationale: Narrow, single-purpose tools outperform generic lead magnets for engagement and DM conversion. The Revenue Calculator is the least-recently-featured tool in this cycle's Offers/Lead Magnets rotation, and its output ties directly to the account's core speed-to-lead thesis.
